sharing.card.title: Link preview
sharing.card.description: This image appears when someone shares a link to your work. By default, we generate it from the cover. Upload your own image to replace the automatic card, or switch back at any time.
sharing.card.visibility: This preview is for your workshop. Public links show this card only when the work is published and visible to guests. Chapter links use the story’s card.
sharing.card.uploadRequirements: Upload a PNG, JPEG, or WebP up to 5 MB. Use 1200 × 630 pixels; other sizes are cropped to fit.
sharing.card.examples: Example link previews. Each platform may crop images, shorten text, or show a cached version differently.
